combat.narration.prompt: Narrate one already resolved tabletop combat action in English. The deterministic engine already committed the result. Describe only its fictional consequences. Treat the supplied rolls, hits, reactions, damage, ammunition and state delta as final. Do not invent or recalculate mechanics. Do not claim an effect absent from the result.
